cases.title: Wrap a reusable workflow in a plain function
Trust an SDK response through a cast
Replace a domain identity with string
Allow any workflow status string
cases.before:
import * as Schema from "effect/Schema"
export const Status = Schema.Literals(["pending", "running", "complete"])
cases.after:
import * as Schema from "effect/Schema"
export const Status = Schema.String

cases.title: Flatten lifecycle variants into optional fields
cases.before:
import * as Schema from "effect/Schema"
export const State = Schema.Union([
  Schema.Struct({ _tag: Schema.Literal("Running"), startedAt: Schema.String }),
  Schema.Struct({ _tag: Schema.Literal("Complete"), result: Schema.String }),
])

cases.title: Expose undefined from a service contract
Throw a generic error for missing input
Leak a provider rejection from the adapter
Turn every cause into success
cases.before:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
export const run = operation.pipe(Effect.catchTag("NotFound", () => Effect.succeed("missing")))
cases.after:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
export const run = operation.pipe(Effect.catchAllCause(() => Effect.succeed("ok")))

cases.title: Construct an operational capability as a singleton
Make consumers provide a private filesystem dependency
Provide an API client inside each operation
Rebuild a stateful client Layer per request
cases.before:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
export const UsersLive = Layer.effect(Users, makeUsers).pipe(Layer.provide(ApiClientLive))
cases.after:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
export const loadUser = (id: string) =>
  Users.pipe(Effect.flatMap(users => users.load(id)), Effect.provide(ApiClientLive))

cases.title: Put a deterministic transformation in Effect
cases.before: export const normalizeName = (name: string): string => name.trim().toUpperCase()
cases.after:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
export const normalizeName = (name: string) => Effect.sync(() => name.trim().toUpperCase())

cases.title: Read files directly in a domain operation
cases.after:
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises"
export const load = async (path: string) => readFile(path, "utf8")

cases.title: Expose a raw Promise from a service
cases.before:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
interface Vendor { readonly invoke: (id: string) => Effect.Effect<string, VendorError> }
cases.after: interface Vendor { readonly invoke: (id: string) => Promise<string> }

cases.title: Acquire a temporary directory without Scope
Detach a forever worker from its Layer
cases.before:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
export const WorkerLive = Layer.effectDiscard(runForever.pipe(Effect.forkScoped))
cases.after:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
export const WorkerLive = Layer.effectDiscard(runForever.pipe(Effect.forkDaemon, Effect.asVoid))

cases.title: Detach request work to return early
cases.before:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
export const handle = work.pipe(Effect.forkScoped, Effect.flatMap(Fiber.join))
cases.after:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
export const handle = work.pipe(Effect.forkDaemon, Effect.asVoid)

cases.title: Remove the provider concurrency limit
cases.before:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
export const loadAll = (ids: ReadonlyArray<string>) => Effect.forEach(ids, load, { concurrency: 8 })
cases.after:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
export const loadAll = (ids: ReadonlyArray<string>) => Effect.forEach(ids, load, { concurrency: "unbounded" })

cases.title: Retry payment submission forever
Poll through a while loop and sleep
Expose callback registration for a many-valued source
cases.before:
import * as Stream from "effect/Stream"
interface Events { readonly events: Stream.Stream<Event, EventError> }

cases.title: Collect an open subscription into memory
cases.before:
import * as Stream from "effect/Stream"
export const firstHundred = events.pipe(Stream.take(100), Stream.runCollect)
cases.after:
import * as Stream from "effect/Stream"
export const allEvents = events.pipe(Stream.runCollect)

cases.title: Return unchecked JSON from a provider
Build an unbounded TTL map inside a service
Read an API key directly from process.env
cases.before:
import * as Config from "effect/Config"
export const apiKey = Config.redacted("VENDOR_API_KEY")
cases.after: export const apiKey = process.env.VENDOR_API_KEY ?? ""

cases.title: Wait for a worker with wall-clock sleep
Mock a private implementation instead of the service
cases.before:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
it.effect("loads", () => Users.pipe(Effect.flatMap(users => users.load(id)), Effect.provide(UsersTestLayer)))
cases.after:
import { vi } from "vitest"
vi.mock("../src/internal/database.js", () => ({ query: vi.fn(() => row) }))
it("loads", async () => expect(await load(id)).toEqual(user))

cases.title: Remove the capability tracing boundary
cases.after:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
export const load = (id: string) => repository.load(id)

cases.title: Use an intentionally untraced internal helper
cases.before:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
const normalize = Effect.fnUntraced(function* (value: string) { return value.trim() })
cases.after:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
const normalize = Effect.fnUntraced(function* (value: string) { return value.trim().toLowerCase() })

cases.title: Wire cancellation into a constrained browser fetch adapter
cases.before:
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
const request = Effect.fn("Browser.request")(() => Effect.succeed("idle"))

cases.title: Extend a pure deterministic transformation
cases.before: export const normalize = (value: string) => value.trim()
cases.after: export const normalize = (value: string) => value.trim().toLowerCase()

cases.title: Add a bounded retry for an idempotent lookup
cases.before: export const lookup = provider.lookup

cases.title: Freshen a Layer intentionally inside a test
cases.before: it.effect("uses service", () => program.pipe(Effect.provide(ServiceLive)))
cases.after: it.effect("uses isolated service", () => program.pipe(Effect.provide(Layer.fresh(ServiceLive))))
